name: ReTerraForged
description: Terrain generation for Minecraft 1.21.1 with configurable archipelagos, island mountains, coast and biome fixes. Legacy V2 is the default CPU path for both RTF terrain and the original cave-density graph. QUICK_V2 and QUICK_V1 remain optional alternate algorithms using Alysara/quick-noise (MIT/Apache-2.0); OpenCL is opt-in. Compatibility architecture was informed by FastFlow (PG 2024), C2ME, and the Khronos OpenCL 1.2 specification. Notices are bundled.
